_comment: A dashboard theme. Drop this in ~/.config/immich_kiosk_pi/themes/ as
<something>.json and it appears in the theme picker, in the browser
editor and in Settings -> Dashboard. Reusing the id of a shipped theme
replaces it, which is how you adjust a built-in without editing the app.
Colours are #rrggbb or #aarrggbb. Themes are read at startup.
name: My theme
//background: One colour is flat; two make a diagonal gradient.
//surface: The tile behind each widget. Fully transparent (#00000000) with a transparent border gives a flat look with no panels at all.
//accent: What the eye should land on first — the time, a temperature, the progress bar.
//gap: Space between tiles, in pixels. Larger suits sparse layouts.
//fontFamily: Null uses the app's own font.
//shadow: Soft shadow under each tile. Turn off for flat and light themes.
